news.title: trunk/78589bea5b32747f9a1f8d9315a48ecf52029d7a: [jit] Add stacklevel=2 to TorchScript deprecation warnings. (#200204)
news.dek:
Summary: 
 Author Notes 
 Our training logs showed  torch.jit  deprecation warnings that all pointed at lines inside  torch/jit/ , so we couldn't tell which of our code was calling TorchScript. This PR adds  stacklevel=2  so each warning names the line that called it, and separat
news.aiSummary: This pull request modifies PyTorch's TorchScript deprecation warnings by adding the stacklevel=2 parameter. The change ensures that warnings point to the user's calling code rather than internal torch/jit/ lines, making it easier to identify which parts of a project are using deprecated features.
